facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Nigeria's National Identity Management Commission said on 2 July 2025 that its services were restored, with the NINAuth app downloadable for NIN authentication needs.

NGA.note: States 120 million NIN enrolments but gives no population or share.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Nigeria's NIMC runs the NIN enrolment, modification and verification services itself and announced on 2 July 2025 that technical maintenance on them was complete.

NGA.note: SIM and bank use are checks by private operators, not public registers keyed on the number.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports NIMC saying NIN enrolments reached 120 million as of July 2025, with over 800 mobile enrolment devices deployed.
Biometric Update reports that Nigerians use the virtual NIN for banking operations and that SIM card registration requires the NIN, both disrupted by the portal downtime of June to July 2025.
Biometric Update reports that banking operations and SIM card registration, in banking and telecoms, both rely on the NIN.
